sentences.text: The correct taxonomy of Procerosuchus is still debated, and its anatomy has not been fully described.

Initially, Procerosuchus was classified as a stagonolepidid alongside the genera Rauisuchus and Prestosuchus. Friedrich von Huene later reassigned Procerosuchus to the family Rauisuchidae. In 1972, Alfred Sherwood Romer assigned Procerosuchus as a possible member of the family Proterochampsidae. Krebs in 1976, Chatterjee in 1985, and Carroll in 1988 all considered Procerosuchus to be a rauisuchid. Initially, Procerosuchus was considered an aetosaurian, similar to other Rauisuchian genera like Prestosuchus. It has been suggested that Procerosuchus is a member of the subfamily Rauisuchinae.
Procerosuchus does not appear to belong to Clade X (now known as Poposauroidea), a monophyletic group of rauisuchians that includes poposaurids and ctenosauriscids.

Fossils of Procerosuchus come from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation in the Paleorrota Geopark of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, which dates to the Carnian age. Procerosuchus lived during the Ladinian stage, between 241.464 and 237 million years ago.
